text:
Ava: Heads up — we need a quick decision on long-tail audit sampling for enterprise BYOK customers. Legal is pushing for 90d full fidelity for SOC2, but storage cost will explode. Proposed: full fidelity = 90d for critical events, 1:10 sampled for 1yr, 1:100 for 3+ yrs. Thoughts? @Priya @Diego @Sam
Priya: Agree with the high-level approach but we need a concrete definition of 'critical events' (authn failures, key ops, admin changes?). Also add an escape-hatch for legal holds / e-discovery.
Diego: Technically doable. We can tag events at ingest and apply sampling policies per-tenant. Concern: sampled logs can hamper forensic reconstruction — consider keeping compact integrity hashes for dropped events so we can prove sequence continuity.
Sam: From CS perspective customers will push back if we sample by default. Recommend default = no-sampling for Enterprise seats, sampling opt-in or contract-level for others. We should surface this in the onboarding checklist.
Ava: Good point. New proposal: Enterprise tenants get configurable retention buckets with sane defaults (full 90d / sampled 1yr / archive 3yr). Sales/legal can request overrides in contract; flag overrides as 'contracted_retention' metadata on tenant.
Priya: Also need to align with BYOK lifecycle: if customer rotates/destroys keys, we must ensure we either preserve needed audit material (via escrow) or clearly document that full-fidelity logs may become inaccessible. KMS team wants a mapping table of key state -> retention behavior.
Diego: Minimal retention config example to enforce at routing layer: ```json
{"tenant_id":"T-123","retention":{"hot_days":90,"warm_sample_rate":10,"cold_sample_rate":100}}
``` This keeps enforcement simple and debuggable.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: retention-config-service v1.3 -> canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Watch alerts: retention.enforce.error and retention.policy.mismatch.
Ava: :thumbsup: Next steps: (1) @Priya define 'critical events' list and legal-hold escape hatch, (2) @Diego prototype ingest sampler + compact-hash store, (3) @Sam update contract language + customer comms. I'll draft the default tenant config and pricing uplift for long-retention.
Priya: On it. I'll draft the events list and post a PR to docs by EOD Thursday, include e-discovery examples.
Diego: I'll put up a branch with a simple sampler and perf numbers by EOD Friday. Early estimate: long-tail sampling reduces storage ~7x for older tiers. Will also prototype the integrity hash approach (sha256 chain).
Sam: I'll prepare an FAQ and inform AEs. FYI two enterprise prospects already asked for 5yr full logs — will surface for pricing discussion.
Ava: Noted — we'll include a 'long-retention surcharge' option and an explicit BYOK escrow add-on. If no blockers, I'll lock defaults next week and circulate for final sign-off. Thanks team.
